decisions.reason: Approval of the landing page's top-half visual design does not change its responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance; the separate item 3 acceptance is already represented.
The general approval of the top-half design does not establish any change to the existing font or button-color token preferences.
Proceeding with the approved top half does not change the implementation stack or handoff objective.
Approval of the landing page's top half does not necessarily alter treatment of follow-on pages; the separate item 2 acceptance is already represented.
The landing-page approval does not change console-shell styling; the same message's separate item 4 decision is already represented under this Requirement.
The source approves only the top half of the landing page, while the proposed footer is at the bottom and remains unaffected.
